descriptionHtml:
Bug B12 · P1 · new

Quick Dictation assigned to a patient whose encounter was last edited 18+ hours ago is appended to yesterday's encounter, so yesterday's dictation lands in today's note

Tickets: TFA-92582 ready for qa · counts as a QA bug: yes · found on: local

Note: Only while the cleanup job has not run yet

Approach · TC-04 Quick Dictation (Hospital only; TC-05 Rounding Sheet merged in) · S27 Assign around the 18 h encounter window (server clock), and the core flow on a device clock a day ahead

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U2 Each box has 'Assign to patient', which opens a patient picker. Assigning appends the box's text verbatim to the end of that patient's encounter note and marks the box as assigned. (UAT TC-04; TFA-92582 AC 3; TFA-92582 steps 2-3)
  • U4 An unassigned box stays on the pad after Quick Dictation is closed and reopened, as the physician's own log. Boxes are never silently dropped. (The UAT says 'stays on the sheet'; … (UAT TC-04; TFA-92582 AC 5; TFA-92582 step 5; TFA-92583 AC 4)

Test design technique: Boundary values (boundary) — Sit right on the edge of the rule (exactly on time / a minute late, empty, longest, most) and see on which side the behavior changes.

Given Part 1 (api): QA Hosp Patel (415) and QA Hosp Ortiz (416), each with encounterNotes 'Day 1: CHF exacerbation, diuresing.'; encounterEditedAt set through rounding:update to now − 17 h (Patel) and now − 19 h (Ortiz) on the server clock; no lifecycle run since. …

When Part 1: quickDictation:assign 'Bed 415, net negative 1.2 L.' to Patel and 'Bed 416, net negative 1.2 L.' to Ortiz, then rounding:applyLifecycle. Part 2: S01's core steps — type a room box, Link, close and reopen the pad, reload the list, open the chart

Then 17 h: both paragraphs stay in today's encounter, Day 1 first. 19 h: today's encounter is the box only, and the Day 1 text is kept as yesterday's transcript (3.6: 18 h, then yesterday's transcript). Part 2: same boxes and marks as a normal run, the placed text still in encounterNotes after the list reloads (not archived), admission badge unchanged

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Playwright API assertions from 3.6 and 3.8: Patel encounterNotes === 'Day 1: CHF exacerbation, diuresing. Bed 415, net negative 1.2 L.'; Ortiz encounterNotes === 'Bed 416, net negative 1.2 L.' and a transcriptHistory entry holds 'Day 1: CHF exacerbation, diuresing.' (assign must not restart yesterday's encounter clock). …

Where it ran: local newspec-b (new Playwright specs); test method TIME · Time / aging (clock moved); lane planned in the matrix: existing tests (Tim's Playwright) (blocked)

S27 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-04.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 1 row.

Issue type: New product issue · environment local · tickets TFA-92582 ready for qa; TFA-92583 ready for qa

Assigning a Quick Dictation box to a patient whose encounter was last edited 19 h ago adds it under yesterday's encounter text instead of starting today's, so yesterday's dictation would go into today's note and is never kept as yesterday's transcript.

Evidence: newspec-b Part 1: at 17 h the result is correct; at 19 h the encounter keeps 'Day 1: …', encounterEditedAt restarts at now and transcriptHistory stays [] after applyLifecycle. Cause: quickDictation:assign restarts the clock without the 18 h rollover (UAT 3.6, TC-04 U2). Only predicted in the TC-04 risks. Part 2: on a device clock one day ahead the core flow is the same, but the badge roll is known (TFA-92584 AC 8). Also observed: the saved session is refused on that clock, so the physician has to sign in again.

Environment: local — main e02167f → 25acd727 (10-15/16/17 re-tests), local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane newspec-b.

Test method: TIME · Time / aging (clock moved) (TIME (encounterEditedAt back-dated through rounding:update, then applyLifecycle)); secondary: PW · Playwright script — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: newspec-b.

UAT item: TC-04 Quick Dictation (Hospital only; TC-05 Rounding Sheet merged in) · Section: A1 · Home Screen & Dashboard · Scenario: TC-04/S27

Assign around the 18 h encounter window (server clock), and the core flow on a device clock a day ahead

Tickets: TFA-92582 Quick Dictation (ready for qa); TFA-92583 Rounding Sheet (ready for qa)

New local lane newspec-b: status failed in newspec-b/results.json → failed · product (failed · product (the lane flagged a product issue)).

How it is tested (newspec-b/plan.json, automatable: yes): Part 1 (API, fresh account): Patel/Ortiz with encounterNotes 'Day 1…', encounterEditedAt = now−17 h / now−19 h via rounding:update, quickDictation:create+assign, then the lifecycle (rounding:applyLifecycle if callable, else a list read that runs it); assert encounterNotes and transcriptHistory. Part 2 (chromium): context clock +1 day and timezoneId Pacific/Kiritimati, S01 core steps; compare quickDictation:list / encounterNotes to the expected; a badge roll reported as known TFA-92584. — encounterEditedAt is a field rounding:update accepts (no aging helper); the device clock is page.clock + timezoneId.

Detail:

Re-run 17:03. Part 1 (server clock, API): 17 h → Patel 'Day 1: CHF exacerbation, diuresing.

Bed 415, net negative 1.2 L.' (correct). 19 h → Ortiz 'Day 1: CHF exacerbation, diuresing.

Bed 416, net negative 1.2 L.', encounterEditedAt restarted at now, transcriptHistory [] — rounding:applyLifecycle afterwards updated 0 rows, because assign had already restarted the clock. Part 2 (device clock +1 day, Pacific/Kiritimati) passes: after signing in again, boxes, marks and encounterNotes equal a correct-clock run; the admission badge rolled NEW → Follow-up (encTypeDay 2026-10-15) = known TFA-92584. The refused saved session on that clock is not a TC-04 oracle; it is filed under _observations for OAT-01/S07.

Product issue: Narrow window, low severity: if a Quick Dictation box is assigned to a patient whose encounter was last edited more than 18 h ago and the app has not run its lifecycle pass since the 18 h mark, the box is appended to yesterday's encounter text — the physician sees 'Day 1: …' above today's words in today's encounter (it would go into today's note) and yesterday's text is never kept as a transcript. Window: the app runs rounding:applyLifecycle on every load and every 10 min while open (AppLayout.tsx ContextLifecycle, no run on return to the foreground), so it needs a tab or phone left open across the 18 h mark and an assign before the next pass — at most ~10 min with the app in the foreground (longer if a backgrounded phone's timer was paused). Breaks UAT 3.6 (encounter 18 h, then yesterday's transcript) / TC-04 U2. Mechanism: quickDictation:assign appends and restarts encounterEditedAt without applying the 18 h rollover itself.

Evidence: 3 attached.

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
